examples: See at a glance that a session was cleared twice, rewound once and compacted three times, and when it slept (long sleeps are squeezed to a labeled break so the working hours get the width).
Read the band beside each rail to see when a conversation was busy, when it sat idle and when it was waiting on you.
Spot the exact message a rewind was cut from, read the messages around it, and branch from there.
Find the conversation backup taken just before a risky change and open a copy of it (conversation backups are the save plugin, so it must be on).
Put the timeline anywhere, wide or narrow, and read it top to bottom with every mark named.
Ask an agent for session_timeline_get to read a session's conversations, splits, compacts, sleeps and busy minutes.
how_to: Drop the session timeline widget from the widget drawer onto either rail, or onto a dashboard (at least 192 by 96).

Time always runs down, at every width and in every host: oldest at the top and now at the bottom, with each conversation named in the words column beside the rail, and a bracket from a fork or rewind goes back to the message it was cut from. A short box scrolls.

The key in the header shows each kind with its own shape and count; click one to hide or show it. The same switches, and squeeze long sleeps, are in the widget menu; the choice is kept on this device.
Hover or focus a mark to see what it is in the detail; pick it (click, or Enter) to read the chat messages around it and act. Close marks merge into a counted box; pick it to list them.

Actions on the picked point: branch here, rewind here (tick the arm box first), bookmark this, open a copy (restores a conversation backup through the save plugin, which must be on) and open conversation. They are also widget menu items, blocked with the reason until they apply.
Keyboard: tab into the rail, up and down (or left and right) step through time, Home and End jump, Escape clears.
On a dashboard pick another session in the session picker; it follows the focused session by default. On a phone the widget is a list in time order.
media_exempt: needs a real session with a lineage, bookmarks and conversation backups; a capture slot has none, so no image is recorded yet
name: Session timeline
summary: a session's conversations on a time axis from oldest to now, with its compacts, bookmarks, restarts, sleeps and conversation backups on it, no label ever under a mark, a real ruler, a busy, idle and waiting band, split points drawn back to the message they were cut from, and branch, rewind and open-a-copy on any picked point.
